title: PasswordResetRequestedIntegrationEvent
description: Published by Auth after storing only the token hash; consumed by Notification (sends the password-reset e-mail). Contract source: backend/c#/OmniCore.Services.Auth/OmniCore.Services.Auth.Contracts/Events/PasswordResetRequestedIntegrationEvent.cs.

Username.description: Used as the display name in the mail.

Token.description: Secret: the raw single-use reset code that goes into the e-mailed link. Only its SHA-256 is stored in security_tokens; consumers must not log it.
